transcript:
# LONDONDERRY, NH PLANNING BOARD

## MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF OCTOBER 7, 2026

## AT THE MOOSE HILL COUNCIL CHAMBERS

**Meeting Link:** http://173.166.17.35/internetchannel/show/14365?channel=4

**Members Present:** Jake Butler, Chair; Jeff Penta, Vice Chair; Art Rugg, Secretary; Tony DeFrancesco, Assistant Secretary; John Farrell, Member; Giovanni Verani, Ex-Officio; Shawn Faber, Town Council Ex-Officio; Jason Knights, Alternate; Ryan Ouellette, Alternate; Brent Lyskawa, Alternate (joined at 7:05 p.m.)

**Members Absent:** Ann Chiampa, Member; Jonathan Cruz, Ex-Officio

**Also Present:** Sylvia von Aulock, Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission; Dave Wholley, DPW Director

## I. CALL TO ORDER

Chair Butler called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. and led the Pledge of Allegiance. He appointed Ryan Ouellette to vote for Ann Chiampa.

## II. ADMINISTRATIVE BOARD WORK

### A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

**A. Rugg made a motion to approve the minutes of August 5, 2026, as presented. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

**A. Rugg made a motion to approve the minutes of September 2, 2026, as presented. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 6-0-2, with J. Penta and R. Ouellette abstaining. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

**A. Rugg made a motion to approve the minutes of September 9, 2026, as presented. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 6-0-2, with J. Penta and A. Rugg abstaining. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

### B. REGIONAL IMPACT DETERMINATION

There were no cases of regional impact.

### C. DISCUSSIONS WITH TOWN STAFF

**T. DeFrancesco made a motion to approve the six-month extension request for Vista East and Vista West to April 14, 2027, A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

**A. Rugg made a motion to approve the 60-day extension request for 222 Rockingham Road to December 9, 2026, J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

**A. Rugg made a motion to approve the 90-day extension request for 162 Litchfield Road, Green Energy, to January 13, 2027. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

The Board thanked Alecia LaFlamme, Land Use Assistant, for her work and acknowledged the extra hours she is working.

## III. NEW PLANS / CONCEPTUAL PLANS

### A. Public hearing on an application for an amended site plan and associated improvements. 6 Dickey Street, Map 10, Lot 109 zoned Commercial-2 (C-II). Leon & Tamara Lampes (Owner/Applicant).

Chair Butler read the case into the record.

S. von Aulock noted the applicants' original plan was approved in the spring. They have requested changes that include reducing the 22-foot access to 17 feet. The NFPA calls for a 20-foot minimum for a commercial entity for Fire Department access. Staff recommends that the applicants request a waiver from the state Fire Marshal or leave the access at the existing 20 feet.

Leon and Tamara Lampes appeared before the Board and clarified that the existing driveway is 20 feet. Their engineer submitted incorrect plans to the Board showing a 22-foot driveway, which the Board approved. The applicants would like the driveway to be 20 feet, to avoid having to remove trees and change the drainage plan.

Chair Butler noted the site plan, Staff memorandum, and all other requests cite 17 feet, so this needs to be changed to 20 feet. Mr. Lampes believes the engineer was confused by the width of the street being 17 feet, and submitted incorrect plans. An updated site plan is needed that reflects the 20-foot driveway, which will resolve this issue. The Board noted that a drainage system designed for a 22-foot driveway would still operate for a 20-foot driveway.

Chair Butler reviewed the conditions of approval.

Chair Butler opened public comment; there was none. Chair Butler closed public comment.

**J. Farrell made a motion to approve the application for an amended site plan and associated improvements for 6 Dickey Street, Map 10, Lot 109 zoned Commercial-2 (C-II), Leon & Tamara Lampes (Owner/Applicant), with the additional precedent condition that the site plan is updated to reflect a 20-foot driveway. S. Faber seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

## IV. STAFFING UPDATE

DPW Director Wholley thanked Alecia LaFlamme, Sylvia von Aulock, and Deputy DPW Director James Danis for their help, in light of the retirement of Director of Engineering and Environmental Services John Trottier. Interviews are currently underway for a Town Engineer, which is a newly created position within the Department of Public Works.

Director Wholley introduced the new Director of Planning and Economic Development, Jacob LaFontaine, who shared information about his background.

## V. NEW PLANS / CONCEPTUAL PLANS (continued)

### B. Public hearing on an application for formal review of a lot line adjustment. 16 & 22 Delta Drive, Map 14 Lot 21-4 and 21-11 zoned Industrial-II (IND-II), 16 Delta Drive Owner LLC and 17 & 22 Delta Drive Owner LLC. (Owner/Applicant).

Chair Butler read the case into the record.

S. von Aulock reviewed the work done to determine that this is a lot line adjustment, noting easements have been identified. She also reviewed the outstanding checking items and recommended that they be waived for acceptance purposes only.

**J. Farrell made a motion to accept the application as complete, with any outstanding checklist items becoming conditions of approval. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

Jim Petropoulos of IMEG Corp and Shawn Smith of R.J. Kelly appeared before the Board to discuss a lot line adjustment between two industrial properties. J. Petropoulos described the property and the proposed lot line adjustment, transferring approximately 3 acres to the 21 Delta parcel. He noted that the stormwater system will be located on a different lot than the two-story structure at 16 Delta; an easement will be granted to address this. They intend to relocate the stormwater system at a later date. There are time restraints, due to the pending sale of 16 Delta.

J. Petropoulos reviewed the two waiver requests from plan scale and rims and inverts. He asked that the conditions to hold a preconstruction meeting and to provide a financial guarantee be removed, as no construction is proposed. The Board agreed.

Chair Butler asked for Board comment.

The Board discussed the Conservation Commission's concern regarding having to cross wetlands to access the transferred acreage, but noted that when the stormwater system is moved, this will no longer be an issue.

Chair Butler asked for public comment; there was none. Chair Butler closed public comment.

**J. Farrell made a motion to grant waivers 1 and 2, as they can be granted without substantial detriment to the public good. R. Ouellette seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

**J. Farrell made a motion to grant conditional approval of a lot line adjustment at 16 & 22 Delta Drive, Map 14 Lot 21-4 and 21-11 zoned Industrial-II (IND-II), 16 Delta Drive Owner LLC and 17 & 22 Delta Drive Owner LLC. (Owner/Applicant), striking precedent condition 9 and general and subsequent condition 1. R. Ouellette seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

### C. Public hearing on an application for formal review of a subdivision of an existing residential lot into two (2) lots in the Agricultural Residential I (AR-1) Zone. 115 Hovey Road, Tax Map 12 Lot 138, Diamond Edge Realty & Development, LLC (Owner/Applicant).

Chair Butler read the case into the record.

J. Farrell stepped away from the meeting.

**R. Ouellette made a motion to accept the application as complete. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 7-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

J. Farrell returned to the meeting.

S. von Aulock noted that the Town has a stricter abutter noticing policy than the state, so more abutters are being noticed. She reviewed the outstanding checklist items.

George Chadwick with Bedford Design Consultants appeared before the Board to discuss subdividing a lot into two parcels of 2.5 acres with the existing home and a 6.1-acre building lot for a four-bedroom home. The driveways are at 8%; he reviewed the erosion controls that will be in place. They will grant two easements to the Town for road widening and stormwater drainage. There are three waiver requests from plan scale, utility clearance letter, and traffic impact analysis.

Chair Butler asked for public comment.

**Amos Goble, 105 Hovey Road,** abutter, asked about access to the new lot. G. Chadwick explained the driveway is off Hovey Road, so will be several hundred feet away from A. Goble's driveway.

**Lynda Goble, 105 Hovey Road,** asked about the plans for the bottom of the L-shaped lot. G. Chadwick explained he cannot speak to what the future homeowner will do with the property, although the proposed house location is in line with the existing house.

Chair Butler closed public comment.

**J. Farrell made a motion to grant waivers 1, 2, and 3, as they can be granted without substantial detriment to the public good. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

The Board noted that while the Conservation Commission recommended that a snow storage area be designated, this is not done on residential applications. The Commission also requested that erosion controls be in place during construction, which is addressed on the plan.

**J. Farrell made a motion to grant conditional approval of a subdivision of an existing residential lot into two (2) lots in the Agricultural Residential I (AR-1) Zone. 115 Hovey Road, Tax Map 12 Lot 138, Diamond Edge Realty & Development, LLC (Owner/Applicant). J. Penta seconded the motion.**

Discussion: S. von Aulock noted there were 11 precedent conditions and 5 general and subsequent conditions.

**The motion carried 8-0-0. Chair votes in the affirmative.**

## VI. OLD BUSINESS

None

## VII. OTHER BUSINESS

Chair Butler warned applicants that neither he nor the Town of Londonderry will email them asking for money. This is a scam.

## VIII. ADJOURNMENT

**R. Ouellette made a motion to adjourn the meeting. J. Penta seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.**

The meeting was adjourned at 7:53 p.m.

These minutes were prepared by Beth Hanggeli.

Respectfully submitted,

[signature]

**Name:** Arthur Rugg

**Title:** Secretary

These minutes were accepted and approved on 11-4-2026 by a motion made by A. Rugg and seconded by J. Farrell.
